title: Prefer the Composition API with <script setup>
guideline: Use <script setup> for new components; it's terser and better for TypeScript inference

title: Be consistent about ref vs reactive
guideline: Use ref for primitives, reactive for objects, and don't mix patterns arbitrarily in one file

title: Scope Pinia stores by domain, not globally
guideline: Create focused stores (useAuthStore, useCartStore) instead of one giant app store

title: Lazy-load route components
guideline: Use dynamic import() for route components to keep the initial bundle small

title: Prefer computed over watch for derived state
guideline: Use computed() when a value is purely derived; reserve watch for real side effects

title: Always key v-for with a stable id
guideline: Provide a stable :key (not index) for reorderable/filterable v-for lists

title: Use slots for flexible component composition
guideline: Prefer scoped slots over prop-explosion for components with variable content
